- **Port to Minecraft 26.3** (Fabric Loader 0.19.5, Fabric API 0.160.6+26.3).
- **Improvement**: `/ed hotspot` now accepts an optional MSPT threshold — e.g. `/ed hotspot 0.5` or `/ed hotspot 1`. Defaults to 2 ms when omitted.
